learningObjectives: Identify common regular expression patterns and metacharacters.
Use Python's re module to search, match, and replace text.
Build patterns for validating and extracting structured information.

activities.title: Regex Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the components of a regular expression.

content.concept: Regular expressions describe text patterns using character classes, quantifiers, groups, and anchors.

activities.title: Pattern Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the regex pattern that matches the required text.

content.concept: Regex patterns can describe digits, words, whitespace, repeated characters, and many other text structures.

activities.title: Regex Builder
activities.instruction: Build a pattern that validates a four-digit PIN.

content.concept: Character classes and quantifiers can be combined with anchors to describe an exact input format.

activities.title: Pattern Tester
activities.instruction: Choose the pattern that correctly validates the target input.

content.concept: A regex should describe the complete structure you intend to validate. Anchors can prevent valid-looking substrings from being accepted as the entire input.
